title: North Jeolla to mount solo bid for 2036 Summer Olympics after talks with Seoul fall through
caption:
North Jeolla Province is pivoting to a solo bid for the 2036 Summer Olympics. After previously aiming to partner with Seoul due to infrastructure gaps, the province is now moving ahead on its own to compete against six other international candidates.

Source: En - North Jeolla to mount solo bid for 2036 Summer Olympics after talks with Seoul fall through
